description: This file provides helper extensions for the ChannelsSettings class, including methods to convert milliseconds to Date objects and to generate NSImage objects from base64-encoded data URLs.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings+Helpers
classes.description: Extension providing helper methods for date parsing and image decoding related to channel settings.

methods.name: date(fromMs:)
methods.description: Converts milliseconds since epoch to a Date object.

methods.name: qrImage(from:)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded image from a data URL string.
